mentions.name: Isomorphic
mentions.description: An open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) that sits between the user and a markdown knowledge base in GitHub, working like Obsidian but inside Claude web, ChatGPT web, and similar AI interfaces rather than as a separate UX. Organizations keep their knowledge separate from the AI and interoperable, building knowledge brains for customers, projects, and internal teams, conformant to Google's Open Knowledge Format. Includes learnings around permissioning, version control, and search, with planned security features that catch stale information and sensitive uploads.
mentions.problem: Deploying LLM-wikis for business teams ran into issues because no one wanted to learn git or GitHub, even when Claude handled most of it.
mentions.audience: Organizations building knowledge bases for customers, projects, and internal teams, including both technical and business teams.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built Isomorphic, an open-source MCP that sits between the user and a markdown knowledge base in GitHub. It's kind of like Obsidian but it's "inside" Claude web, ChatGPT web, etc. Not a separate UX. Organizations keep their knowledge separate from the AI and interoperable, helps org build brains for customers, projects, internal teams. Conformant to Google's Open Knowledge Format.
mentions.author: isomorphic-12
